verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since an on-call scheduling product could plausibly offer an iCal/webcal feed of a user's shifts. However, nothing in the evidence documents subscribing to such a feed from a personal calendar. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: schedules and mobile schedule views (pagerduty-docs-12, pagerduty-docs-91), the Shift Agent, which reads calendars to detect conflicts rather than exporting shifts (pagerduty-docs-58), and REST API lookups of who is on call, which are a developer building block (pagerduty-docs-70).
